# Webrick

> Webrick is a digital marketing agency based in India. It builds websites, runs ads on Facebook, Instagram and Google, manages social media, designs branding and creatives, and sets up lead follow-up for small and growing businesses. One team handles the job from start to end.

## Services

- Websites & Online Stores: fast, mobile-first business websites, landing pages and online stores. Live in 2–3 days.
- Paid Ads: Facebook, Instagram and Google ad campaigns, with spend and enquiries tracked.
- Social Media: posts, reels and captions planned, designed and published every week.
- Branding & Creatives: logo, colours, post designs and ad creatives.
- SEO: on-page and local search engine optimisation.
- Leads & Follow-up: enquiries routed to WhatsApp and tracked in a CRM.
- Also builds web apps, mobile apps and custom software on request.

## Products

- SabseraCRM: a calling CRM for sales teams. Leads, click-to-call, call logs, recordings and follow-up reminders in one screen, with a live dashboard per agent.

## How Webrick works

- Plan, Build, Launch, Follow up, Improve.
- Fixed quote before work starts, weekly updates and one point of contact.
- The client's ad budget is paid directly to Meta or Google; Webrick charges a fixed management fee.

## Plans

- Just the website: one-time, custom quote.
- Website + Ads: monthly, custom quote.
- Start to end (website, ads, social media, branding, lead tracking): monthly, custom quote.
- Domain and hosting are in the client's name and billed separately.
